item.title: Schaper leads SA charge for NGC glory
item.description: South Africa’s Jayden Schaper heads into Sunday’s final round of the Nedbank Golf Challenge five shots off the lead of Norway’s Kristoffer Reitan.

item.title: Two eagles lift Straka to lead over Scheffler
item.description: Austrian Sepp Straka seized a one-stroke lead over two-time defending champion Scottie Scheffler at the Hero World Challenge in the Bahamas on Saturday.

item.title: Neergaard-Petersen wins Australian Open, Saffa fourth
item.description: Rasmus Neergaard-Petersen sank a 10-foot pressure putt at the last to edge Cameron Smith and win a maiden DP World Tour title at the Australian Open on Sunday.

item.title: LIVE: 2025 Nedbank Golf Challenge
item.description: Follow the Nedbank Golf Challenge at Sun City.

item.title: Norway’s Reitan wins ‘Africa’s Major’
item.description: Kristoffer Reitan overcame what he described as “excruciating pressure” to become the first Norwegian winner of the Nedbank Golf Challenge at Sun City on Sunday.

item.title: Matsuyama tops Noren in World Challenge playoff
item.description: Former Masters champion Hideki Matsuyama birdied the first hole of a sudden death playoff to beat Alex Noren in the Hero World Challenge in the Bahamas on Sunday.

item.title: Stars hoping to strike gold at Royal Johannesburg
item.description: The Alfred Dunhill Championship’s return to Johannesburg for the first time in two decades has been like a trip down memory lane for several stars in this week’s field.

item.title: Oosthuizen excited to be back in Joburg
item.description: Louis Oosthuizen is looking forward to rekindling his memories of a Royal Johannesburg East Course which he played early in his career before he became a Major champion.
